technical.summary: BLK shows strong structural bullish alignment across moving averages and trend indicators, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend strength with no fresh momentum triggers limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: BLK shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 87 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (bearish 39.9% vs bullish 24%) with neutral fear-greed reading (56 = mild greed); insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (193.9) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 87 days provides buffer but financial sector faces structural headwinds from credit tightening and economic contraction fears.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and Ichimoku above cloud provides structural upside framework, supported by nearest resistance only 706.11 (3.2% upside) offering defined risk/reward.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 9 at 70.01, Stoch K at 83.56) with declining momentum, zero fundamental/smart money support, elevated earnings risk in 87 days, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 193.9, weak ADX at 22.15) create asymmetric downside risk without fresh momentum triggers.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish (price above MAs, supertrend, Ichimoku), but entry occurs at overbought resistance with declining momentum and zero fundamental support—risk/reward asymmetry unfavourable.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in crisis (VIX 193.9, inverted yield curve, weak ADX trend confirmation) combined with overbought oscillators and earnings in 87 days creates high probability of mean reversion into financial sector headwinds.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
